name: Protagonist
source:
The protagonist of Lovewood is named Quince by default if no other name is entered. While the name and pronouns can be chosen, some other characteristics about them are set in stone.

They are a healer who freshly moves to the town of Liebwald in the beginning of the game, trying to start a life of their own. Their magical talents are healing physical injuries and creating light. They are a little socially anxious and draw and paint in their free time, and they are rather knowledgable in botany as well.
They have not been in a romantic relationship before the beginning of the game, and it is suggested that they are in their early twenties.

Most of their physical traits are hidden underneath their outfit, but their bear ears and the blonde tufft of hair is usually visible as poking out from underneath their hood.

In Frightwood, the teen protagonist is explicitly called Janus, and it is suggested that he is going to become a version of the Lovewood protagonist later on, sharing all physical characteristics and skills.
